modules.name: whitescreen
build-commands: if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSfL https://sh.rustup.rs -o rustup-init.sh; else wget -O rustup-init.sh https://sh.rustup.rs; fi

mv /app/bin/whitescreen /app/bin/whitescreen-bin
cat > /app/bin/whitescreen <<'WRAP'
#!/bin/sh
# gtk4-layer-shell interposes on libwayland-client and must be loaded before
# it, or its protocol hook never installs and gtk_layer_is_supported() returns
# false even on a compositor that implements the protocol. Rust link order does
# not guarantee this. Setting LD_PRELOAD via the manifest does not work either:
# flatpak clears it during sandbox setup. Doing it here, in-sandbox and
# immediately before exec, is the one place it survives.
for d in /app/lib /app/lib64; do
    if [ -f "$d/liblayer-shell-preload.so" ]; then
        LD_PRELOAD="${LD_PRELOAD:+$LD_PRELOAD:}$d/liblayer-shell-preload.so"
        export LD_PRELOAD
        break
    fi
done
exec /app/bin/whitescreen-bin "$@"
WRAP
chmod +x /app/bin/whitescreen
